actions.name: parse_hs_codes
actions.description: Identify HS codes from a product description using the Panjiva commodity coder. Optionally restrict the HS prefix and enable parser, manual rules or classifier methods; the first matching method supplies the results.

description.description: Product description to classify into HS codes.

partial_hs.description: Optional two- or four-digit HS code prefix that restricts classification results.

use_parser.description: Whether to extract HS codes already present in the description.

use_manual_logic.description: Whether to match predefined classification rules.

use_classifier.description: Whether to use the machine-learning HS classifier.

result_count.description: Number of classification results reported by Panjiva.

description.description: Description associated with the predicted code.

source.description: Classification method that produced the prediction.

actions.name: parse_many_hs_codes
actions.description: Call Panjiva's Parse Many commodity coder and return per-item HS codes and classifier metadata. The published request schema defines items as an object with description, optional marks and partial_hs; pass that documented object shape.

description.description: Product description to classify into HS codes.

marks.description: Shipment marks text accompanying the product description.

partial_hs.description: Optional two- or four-digit HS code prefix that restricts classification results.

items.description: Commodity item object as defined by the official Parse Many request schema.

classifier_training_date.description: Classifier training date reported by Panjiva.

parsed_hs_codes.description: HS codes returned by this classification method.

piers_override.description: HS codes returned by this classification method.

panjiva_override.description: HS codes returned by this classification method.

classifier_codes.description: HS codes predicted by the classifier.

items.description: Classification results for one commodity item.

outputSchema.description: Parse Many classification results and model metadata.
